stall_association.interpretation: Low forward progress coincides with persistent FR-calf load, absent FR-foot current contact, three other current foot contacts and very small action changes. This is consistent with a stable supported configuration and does not identify the measured contact location or the cause of the stall.

measurement_limits: Full 96-environment outcome/terminal-root/terminal-feet records per condition; detailed trace only env480 for each seed, sampled every5policy steps (~100ms). Active first-episode rows only; inactive post-completion/reset samples excluded.

Terminal root x localizes the robot, not the limb/collider contact point. Root may straddle multiple treads. Stored current/history normal-force vectors do not identify exact collision location or geometry; no stretch-condition video was recorded.
Recorded contact-gated world-XY foot link speed and >0.10m/s fraction are slip proxies. History includes retained sensor samples; stride5 misses transients.

Per-case metrics are pooled over eligible active first-episode samples after1s; different success/failure durations affect their denominators. Table and marker means are arithmetic across three seed reports, not newly pooled statistics.

The conditions share saved initial XYZ and matching reported non-friction readbacks, but these are not all simulator state variables. none and basic nominal produce different outcomes despite those equal readbacks. Do not attribute differences to randomized mass/COM: eval dynamics randomized was false.

Associations between commanded speed, material settings, contact support and completion do not establish a general causal mechanism, an optimum speed/friction, reduced scraping or smoothness. Effective solver contact-pair friction coefficients were not read back.
